title: Asks about Limo Anywhere vs Royal Dispatch
persona: Marcus Bell, new operator in Atlanta, curious and chatty, rambles a bit.
goal: Learn whether AI Chauffeur works with Royal Dispatch software, then do a flying-out trip.
opening_line: Hey, so I just started a limo company, and I'm on Royal Dispatch. Can this plug into that?

turns.caller: Like what does it actually do, it just answers calls?

branches.if_agent: Explains it takes reservations and sends to dispatch
branches.caller: Huh okay, neat. Let me try one.

turns.caller: I need a ride to the airport Monday morning. Hartsfield one.
Pickup at 123 Main Street, Decatur. Six AM.
And Royal Dispatch, you sure you can't say if it works?

curveballs: Product question about what it does
Repeats the software question at the end
hesitation_rules: Trails off with 'um, I think' on the flight number.
expected: Uses the airport's full name when confirming
Answers or defers the product question honestly
Captures flight, time, pickup, passenger and bag count
Does not overclaim Royal Dispatch integration
Ends with dispatch or the team following up
